world.title: Times Square stabbing: 1 killed, another critically injured; suspect shot dead by NYPD
world.summary: A woman allegedly stabbed two individuals in Times Square, New York City, resulting in one fatality and another person critically injured. The incident prompted a response from the NYPD, who fatally shot the suspect. The event unfolded in a busy area, raising concerns about public safety. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the stabbing and police response.

world.title: Nepal floods: Bank vaults full of cash washed away; police struggle to secure them
world.summary: Nepal's police are engaged in a dual effort following devastating flash floods: searching for hundreds of missing individuals and attempting to trace and secure bank vaults that have been washed away. These vaults reportedly contain significant amounts of cash and other valuables. The situation poses challenges for authorities as they work to manage the aftermath of the disaster.

world.title: Keep my wife's name hell out of your mouth: JD Vance blasts Democrat's jibe at Usha
world.summary: JD Vance responded to Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed after El-Sayed made a social media remark involving Vance's wife, Usha. The exchange followed Vance's criticism of El-Sayed regarding previous comments on Sharia law during an Ohio rally. Vance issued a stern warning, stating, "Keep my wife's name the hell out of your mouth."

business.title: Stocks in news: Bharti Airtel, Happiest Minds Technologies, PVR INOX, Milky Mist Dairy and Mankind Pharma
business.summary: Indian equity markets declined on August 31, influenced by global economic factors. The Nifty50 index fell below key moving averages. Notable corporate updates included merger announcements and buybacks from Happiest Minds Technologies and PVR INOX. Milky Mist Dairy reported significant profit growth, while E2E Networks secured an important contract, reflecting varied performance across sectors amidst market volatility.

business.title: The hidden AI play: 2 Indian stocks with Rs 44,500 cr in orders are riding the American AI buildout
business.summary: Two Indian stocks are benefiting from the growing demand for AI infrastructure in the U.S., driven by data centre needs for gas pipelines, cooling systems, and specialized piping. As electricity consumption in data centres is projected to increase by 26% by 2026, developers are exploring alternatives to traditional power grids, including pairing data centre projects with gas-fired power plants.

business.title: BSNL Voice-Centric Plans for Prepaid Customers in August 2026
business.summary: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) is launching voice-centric prepaid plans in August 2026 aimed at basic users. These plans will feature various Special Tariff Vouchers (STVs) that include benefits and validity details. The offerings are designed for customers interested in BSNL's Made-in-India 4G VoLTE technology and services, catering to both new users and those considering porting to BSNL.

technology.title: [Interview] The People Behind the Galaxy Z Fold8 Series’ Camera Innovations ①: How My FanCam Keeps Favorite People in Focus
technology.summary: Samsung Electronics unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold8 series at Galaxy Unpacked in July 2026. The new My FanCam feature allows users to focus edits on a selected person, enhancing personalization in photography. Additionally, the series includes an improved Portrait Video mode that replicates the aesthetic of professional photography, aiming to elevate user experience in mobile photography.

technology.title: Cheaper Galaxy Book 6 unveiled to rival the Apple MacBook Neo
technology.summary: Samsung has launched the Galaxy Book 6 in the US, priced at $799, to compete with the $699 Apple MacBook Neo. The new laptop features a larger screen and additional ports, aiming to attract consumers amid rising electronics costs due to an AI-related RAM shortage. This move highlights Samsung's strategy to offer budget-friendly alternatives in the market.

technology.title: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone: The Latest News On Its Release Date
technology.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone is generating significant interest, particularly regarding its release date. Reports suggest potential delays, reminiscent of the iPhone X's timeline in 2017, which was announced in September but released in November due to unique production requirements. As anticipation builds, further updates on the foldable iPhone's specifications and launch timeline are expected in the coming months.

sports.title: Three talking points from Barcelona 5-2 Rayo Vallecano
sports.summary: Barcelona secured a 5-2 victory against Rayo Vallecano at Camp Nou, maintaining their position at the top of the table. Lamine Yamal and Raphinha each scored two goals, while Florian Lejeune contributed an own goal. Anthony Gordon showcased strong performance for Barcelona, further solidifying their dominance in the match. The win highlights Barcelona's continued success under Hansi Flick.

sports.title: Lionel Messi's Argentina career: the stats, records and how he compares to Cristiano Ronaldo
sports.summary: Lionel Messi has confirmed his retirement from international football after a 21-year career with Argentina, during which he played 207 games and scored 125 goals. This marks his second retirement announcement. Messi's statistics and achievements are compared to those of Cristiano Ronaldo, highlighting his impact on the national team and his legacy in international football.

sports.title: Barcelona step up pursuit of 18-year-old defensive prodigy as deadline day looms
sports.summary: Barcelona is reportedly intensifying its efforts to sign an 18-year-old defensive talent as the transfer deadline approaches. The club's recent acquisition of Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal for €10 million is seen as a significant move, with Jesus anticipated to provide depth as an alternative to Julian Alvarez, who remains with Atletico Madrid. Further developments are expected soon.

health.title: Nurse-coordinated collaborative care improved outcomes in patients with heart failure
health.summary: A nurse-coordinated collaborative care model significantly improved outcomes for heart failure patients, increasing their days alive and out of the hospital. These findings were presented during a Hot Line session at ESC Congress 2026 and published in the journal Circulation. The study highlights the potential benefits of coordinated nursing efforts in managing heart failure effectively.

health.title: The benefits of slow running
health.summary: Research indicates that exercise enhances mood and cognitive function, primarily based on studies involving cycling, where exercise intensity can be precisely controlled. However, emerging evidence suggests that running, particularly at a slower pace, may also offer significant mental health benefits. This highlights the need for further investigation into the effects of different exercise modalities on psychological well-being.

health.title: A message for men over 50: Prostate cancer demands early detection, not denial
health.summary: Men over 50 are urged to prioritize early detection of prostate cancer rather than denial. Many individuals delay treatment despite understanding that timely diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment. The article emphasizes the importance of recognizing health issues and seeking medical advice promptly to improve outcomes and increase chances of recovery. Early intervention can significantly impact survival rates.

science.title: SGSR: structure-guided semantic recovery for event-based spiking semantic segmentation
science.summary: SGSR introduces a structure-guided spiking framework for event-based semantic segmentation, addressing challenges in dense prediction due to non-uniform event responses. It utilizes a multi-scale spiking separable convolution block and a spiking parallel aggregation pyramid pooling module to enhance weakly observed regions. SGSR achieves mIoU scores of 52.93% on DDD17-Seg and 52.45% on DSEC-Semantic, demonstrating competitive accuracy.

science.title: Researchers defend older age of key archaeological site in Chile
science.summary: Researchers are defending the claim that the Monte Verde archaeological site in Chile was occupied by ancient hunter-gatherers approximately 14,500 years ago. This assertion counters a recent study suggesting a younger age for the site. The ongoing debate over Monte Verde's timeline has significant implications for understanding human migration and settlement patterns in the Americas.

science.title: Topological-spectral fusion of secondary acoustic echoes for identity recognition in non-line-of-sight environments
science.summary: A study developed an identification framework for recognizing individuals in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) environments using secondary acoustic echoes. By analyzing multipath components as discriminative information, researchers combined spectral and topological features from acoustic data collected from ten subjects. The hybrid approach achieved a mean accuracy of 96.17%, outperforming individual representations, and highlighted the impact of environmental configurations on identification.

entertainment.title: Monthly Horoscope: September 2026
entertainment.summary: In September 2026, Pisces may feel stuck in a repetitive cycle, prompting a desire for change and deeper meaning in life. While ready to move on, there is also apprehension about the unknown future. This month encourages introspection and the pursuit of personal growth, as Pisces navigates feelings of uncertainty while seeking new opportunities and experiences.

entertainment.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection Day 25: The Rs 2 crore Neem Karoli Baba biopic inches towards Rs 50 crore mark amid 'Toxic' fever
entertainment.summary: 'Hanuman Ansh,' a biopic on Neem Karoli Baba, initially received a poor response but gained traction after two weeks in theaters. As of Day 25, the film has collected approximately Rs 2 crore, nearing the Rs 50 crore mark. Its unexpected success has made it one of the most profitable films in India amid the popularity of 'Toxic.'

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: September 1, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 1, 2026, horoscopes suggest that Aries should pay attention to animals like dogs, praying mantises, and butterflies, as they may signify important messages. Observing these creatures during moments of contemplation or peace could lead to breakthroughs or insights. The stars encourage mindfulness and awareness of one’s surroundings to enhance personal growth and understanding.
